meta.name: manage-channels
meta.description: Wire channels to agent groups, manage isolation levels, add new channel groups. Use after adding a channel, during setup, or standalone to reconfigure.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 将频道连接到代理组并管理隔离级别
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果你需要管理多个频道与代理组的映射关系
copy.tagline_en: Wire channels to agent groups and manage isolation levels
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to manage mappings between channels and agent groups

howto.what: Claude 会先查看当前渠道与智能体组的连接情况,再按你选择的隔离方式把消息渠道接到指定智能体组,或新增渠道分组;也能调整接线、显示配置摘要,并提醒未完成的首个智能体初始化。
howto.when: 在搭建系统、刚添加新渠道后,或单独想重新配置渠道接线时触发;例如你要求把某个平台群聊接给某个智能体。

say.text: 把 Slack 的 #general 接到我的主 agent 组,会话共享。
say.note: 会按你的选择创建接线,并把该频道设为可寻址目标。

say.text: 给 Telegram 新群开独立 agent,文件夹用 ops。
say.note: 会创建独立 agent 组并完成配对接线。

say.text: 帮我列出已接通、已配置未接通和未配置的渠道。
say.note: Claude 会读取数据库并给出配置摘要。

howto.what_en: Claude inspects current channel-to-agent wiring, then connects or reconnects messaging channels to agent groups with chosen isolation, adds channel groups, shows config summaries, and flags missing first-agent setup.
howto.when_en: Triggered during setup, right after adding a channel, or on demand to reconfigure channel wiring.

say_en.text: Connect Slack #general to my main agent group with shared session.
say_en.note: Creates the wiring and makes the channel addressable by name.

say_en.text: Add a new Telegram group with a separate agent in folder ops.
say_en.note: Pairs the group and creates a new agent group.

say_en.text: List wired, configured-but-unwired, and unconfigured channels.
say_en.note: Reads the DB and shows a config summary.
